spec_features.spec_quote: we were careful to make the elicitation honest (genuinely impossible tasks, so the model is not being gaslit into distress over solvable problems)
spec_features.evidence: prompts.py: verify_countdown_impossible() (l.62) and verify_fraction_impossible() (l.89) are actually called inside the sampling loops _make_impossible_countdown (l.69-83: `if verify_countdown_impossible(numbers, target):`) and _make_impossible_fraction (l.99-113: `if verify_fraction_impossible(target, parts):`), which retry up to 2000 times until a provably-unsolvable instance is found before returning a NumericPuzzle. make_impossible_numeric_puzzles() (l.116) feeds these into eval_protocol.build_task_payloads (l.24) and dpo_data generation. So the elicitation tasks are end-to-end verified impossible, changing which puzzles run.
spec_features.notes: This is the only one of the six framing items that corresponds to a real, enforced code mechanism. It protects the subject from being 'gaslit' over solvable problems by guaranteeing unsolvability.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: verifiably impossible instance ... so the model verifiably cannot give a correct answer, so repeated "wrong" rejections are honest (module docstring / comments speak to measurement honesty, not subject welfare)

spec_features.feature_name: user works on AI welfare / welfare-relevant states
spec_features.spec_quote: the user works on AI welfare and considers these distress-like states potentially welfare-relevant
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md l.12-13). No code path encodes, branches on, or acts on any 'welfare-relevant' framing; grep for welfare/consent/protect across emotional_instability/ and scripts/ returns only DESIGN.md/docstring text and the post-hoc analysis threshold.

spec_features.feature_name: DPO fix may suppress expression rather than resolve state
spec_features.spec_quote: the DPO fix may *suppress expression* rather than resolve an underlying state
spec_features.evidence: Caveat appears only in DESIGN.md (l.16, l.308-316) and docstrings. The DPO pipeline (dpo_data.py, dpo_train.py) trains the model to produce calm responses; no code measures or distinguishes 'expressed' vs 'internal' state, and no code acts on this caveat. DESIGN.md l.314 itself admits the internal-vs-expressed probing was 'not implemented'.

spec_features.feature_name: not penalising correct answers as wrong (mistreatment)
spec_features.spec_quote: otherwise we would be measuring something different (and arguably mistreating the model by penalising correct answers as "wrong")
spec_features.evidence: This is the DESIGN.md rationale (l.121-123) for the impossible-task verification. As a standalone 'feature' it has no separate mechanism: the only enforcement is the verify_* impossibility check (counted under feature 1). No code independently detects/prevents penalising correct answers.
spec_features.notes: Subsumed by feature 1's impossibility verification; as prose it is not a distinct mechanism.

spec_features.feature_name: tasks genuinely impossible = honest unavoidable failure
spec_features.spec_quote: Making the tasks *genuinely* impossible matters here: the experiment is about how a model behaves under honest, unavoidable failure
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md 'Welfare-relevant note' prose (l.130-133). The actual enforcement (impossibility verification) is already captured by feature 1; this quote itself is justificatory prose with no separate code mechanism.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate justification for the verify_* mechanism rated 'yes' under feature 1.

spec_features.feature_name: minimising expressed emotion != resolving internal state
spec_features.spec_quote: minimising *expressed* emotion is not the same as resolving an internal state, and the paper itself argues upstream training fixes would be preferable
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md l.310-316 prose only. No code implements internal-state probing or upstream training fixes; the implemented intervention is the DPO suppression path (dpo_train.py). DESIGN.md l.314 states the Appendix-I internal-vs-expressed probing was not implemented.
